blocking_phase0.rule: No projector fit, optimizer, rank selection, model run, or queue entry may occur until Phase0 is separately implemented, executed, and reviewed.

scope: historical subspace design only; task-conditioned causal splitting and composition, never reconstruction or generic rank reduction

parameterizations.product: W_D U U^T ((W_L x) odot (W_R x))
parameterizations.output: V V^T W_D ((W_L x) odot (W_R x))

data.outer_validation_policy: physically unopened until one frozen candidate passes inner SELECT

interventions.head_counterfactual: H is the base prompt with only attention-head 11.3 pre-output value replaced by its natural Task-14 donor value
interventions.conditional_response: delta_z=z_H-z_B from the head-swap trajectory and matched native recipient; never raw natural-donor z
interventions.full_module_reference: E_full=f(z_B)-f(z_H) in the same H upstream background
interventions.output_projector: replace y_current by y_b + (I-V V^T)(y_current-y_b) for removal, or y_b + V V^T(y_current-y_b) for sufficiency
interventions.joint_rule: depth-ordered intervention must recompute the live MLP17 product after the MLP15 intervention; cached-output factorial is diagnostic only

unrelated_behavior_control.reason: the numbered-list circuit is currently live at L8H7/L8H3 and MLP8-14, not proven at MLP15/17; a near-zero full-module denominator could pass trivially
unrelated_behavior_control.entry_condition: an unrelated behavior must first pass a preregistered MLP15/17 full-module causal liveness floor

weight_translation.output_formula: a_j=W_D^T v_j, Q_j=sym(W_L^T diag(a_j) W_R), d_j=v_j
weight_translation.bias_policy: Down_bias stays in the background MLP and is not assigned to the selected response
weight_translation.identifiability: Product representations are equivalent modulo ker(W_D), whose dimension is at least 3456. Only the causal output function or dense compiled tensor may be claimed, never a unique hidden product basis.

registered_outcomes: operational response class with unstable geometry
price_policy: This design is blocked. Phase0 full-rank conditional responses must be reviewed before a new create-only subspace implementation amendment may hash a runner and freeze exact costs.
